第21章 升级天武令积分无尽（第1页）
叶凡挠了挠头，一脸疑惑地盯着萧老。
萧老捋了捋胡子，慢悠悠地说道，“其一，拥有天武境修为，以绝对实力碎石碑。其二，拥有六阶神纹师造诣，破解石碑上的神纹！”
叶凡迫不及待地追问，脸上写满了尴尬。
萧老微微一笑，继续说道，“第三种嘛，云隐国皇室有一柄潜龙刀！待你拥有玄武境修为时，执此刀即有碎此石碑之力。”
叶凡嘴角一抽，一脸无语，“难不成，您要我去问云隐国皇室借这柄潜龙刀？他们会给我吗？”
萧老不紧不慢道，“潜龙刀，是储君之刀！如今云隐国储君未定，此刀还在国君手里。如果你能帮助某位皇子夺得储君之位，借一下刀，又有何难？”
“这要是选错了人，可是会没命的。”
叶凡皱了皱眉，心里已开始打退堂鼓。
云隐国皇子众多，目前最有希望夺得储君之位的是二皇子段天枢和三皇子段天涯。
但问题是，段天枢未必看得上他啊！
叶凡翻了个白眼，毫不客气地怼道，“您老都被困在这鬼地方了，还怎么帮我？”
萧老一脸神秘，“你通关真武塔，必定能进入天武书院外院第一院。过阵子外院大比，如果你能夺得外院第一，老夫赠你一份大礼。届时，必有皇子向你抛出橄榄枝，到时就看你如何选择了。”
萧老神秘一笑，故意卖了个关子，“这大礼，可保你今后在天武书院，无人敢惹。”
叶凡皱了皱眉，一脸狐疑地看着萧老。
只有强大实力，才能保自己无人敢惹。
萧老瞪了叶凡一眼，一本正经地说道，“老夫还指着你拿到潜龙刀，帮老夫碎了这块石碑呢！”

叶凡挠了挠头，总觉得哪里不对劲，“我就纳闷了，如果玄武境武者执潜龙刀就能碎此石碑，您老干嘛非要找我？随便找个玄武境的不就行了？”
“这是老夫跟段云隐之间的约定。”
“唯有通关真武塔之人，可斩石碑！”
萧老叹了口气，解释道，“他提出这样的要求，是想刁难老夫，将老夫困死在这里。结果，嘿嘿，还真让老夫等到了。”

Chapter 21 Endless points for upgrading the Tianwu Order (page 1)
Ye Fan scratched his head and stared at Mr. Xiao with a puzzled expression.
Mr. Xiao stroked his beard and said slowly, "First, he has the cultivation level of Tianwu Realm and can crush stone monuments with his absolute strength. Second, he has the attainments of a sixth-level divine pattern master and can crack the divine patterns on stone monuments!"
Ye Fan couldn't wait to ask, his face full of embarrassment.
Mr. Xiao smiled slightly and continued, "The third type is that the royal family of Yunyin Kingdom has a Hidden Dragon Sword! When you reach the Xuanwu realm, holding this sword will have the power to break this stone tablet."
Ye Fan's mouth twitched and he was speechless, "Is it possible that you want me to ask the Yunyin Kingdom royal family to borrow this Hidden Dragon Sword? Will they give it to me?"
Mr. Xiao said calmly, "The Qianlong Sword is the prince's sword! Now that the prince of Yunyin Kingdom has not been decided, the sword is still in the hands of the prince. If you can help a certain prince win the position of prince, what's the problem in borrowing the sword?"
"If you choose the wrong person, you will die."
Ye Fan frowned and began to retreat in his heart.
There are many princes in Yunyin Kingdom, and currently the two most promising princes are the second prince Duan Tianshu and the third prince Duan Tianya.
But the problem is, Duan Tianshu may not like him!
Ye Fan rolled his eyes and said unceremoniously, "How can you help me when you're stuck in this hellish place?"
Mr. Xiao looked mysterious, "You will definitely be able to enter the first courtyard of the outer courtyard of Tianwu Academy after you clear the Zhenwu Tower. There will be a competition in the outer courtyard in a while. If you can win the first place in the outer courtyard, I will give you a big gift. By then, a prince will definitely throw an olive branch to you. It depends on how you choose."
Mr. Xiao smiled mysteriously and deliberately let it slip, "This great gift will ensure that no one dares to offend you in Tianwu Academy from now on."
Ye Fan frowned and looked at Mr. Xiao suspiciously.
Only with great strength can you protect yourself and no one dares to offend you.
Mr. Xiao glared at Ye Fan and said seriously, "I pointed you to the Qianlong Sword and helped me break this stone tablet!"
Ye Fan scratched his head, always feeling that something was wrong, "I'm just wondering, if a Xuanwu realm warrior can break this stone tablet with the Hidden Dragon Sword, why do you always have to find me? Can't you just find someone in the Xuanwu realm?"
"This is the agreement between me and Duan Yunyin."
"Only those who clear the Zhenwu Tower can cut the stone tablet!"
Mr. Xiao sighed and explained, "He made such a request because he wanted to make things difficult for me and trap me here. In the end, hey, he really made me wait."
